title: Agent-kit routing (local/routing.json)
description: Machine-readable copy of local/MODELS.md, written by the setup skill. Hosts such as T3 Code read it to pick a model per role. Keep it in sync with local/MODELS.md.

updatedAt.description: UTC time of the last setup write, ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-27T08:00:00Z.

roles.description: One entry per layer. Verifier is optional: when absent, hosts use the auditor, then the advisor.

leadEffort.description: Lead effort from the setup interview: planning is for kickoff, spec, plan and hard debugging; default is for everything else.

excludedModels.description: Model ids that must never be used on any role. Absent means none.

excludedProviders.description: Providers that must never be used on any role, for example ["gemini"]. Absent means none.

fallback.description: Where workers run when their account is near its limit. Absent when there is one account.

modelOverrides.description: Roles that use a different model on the fallback account.

pools.description: Account pools: several accounts on one host driver that a role uses in turn. When an account hits its usage limit, the next one takes over (tools/next-account.mjs walks the chain). Absent when each role has one account.

provider.description: Lowercase vendor family, for example claude, codex, gemini.

modelId.description: The model id the host sends, for example claude-opus-5-5.

instanceId.description: Host account or provider-instance id, labels only (T3 Code: providerInstanceId).

runsOn.description: Free-text label for where the role runs. Never a token or key.

pool.description: Name of an entry in pools. The role tries those accounts in order. When providerInstanceId is also set, it must be one of them (older tools read only providerInstanceId).

driverKind.description: Host driver every account in the pool uses (T3 Code: driverKind, for example antigravity or claudeAgent).

accounts.description: Account ids in the order to try them (T3 Code: providerInstanceId). Labels only.

addNew.description: true: accounts on the same driverKind that the host lists but accounts does not are tried after the listed ones, in name order. Default false.

cooldownHours.description: How long an account is skipped after it hits its limit, when the error gives no reset time. Default 5.

poolFallback.description: Where the pool's roles run when every account in it is at its limit. After this account, the top-level fallback applies.

models.description: Model per role on this account. Every role that uses the pool needs one.
